LESSON: LISHE BORA

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.23: Lishe Bora

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Lishe Bora. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what Lishe Bora means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Lishe Bora from Kenya
3. practise Lishe Bora in clear steps
4. apply Lishe Bora in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: LISHE BORA
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Lishe Bora helps you succeed in KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: LISHE BORA
Study Lishe Bora like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Lishe Bora means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Lishe Bora means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Lishe Bora means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Lishe Bora”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Lishe Bora means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Lishe Bora from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Lishe Bora from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Lishe Bora from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Lishe Bora.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Lishe Bora from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Lishe Bora in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Lishe Bora in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Lishe Bora in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Lishe Bora.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Lishe Bora in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Lishe Bora in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Lishe Bora in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Lishe Bora in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Lishe Bora”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Lishe Bora in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Lishe Bora is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Lishe Bora”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Lishe Bora means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Lishe Bora. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Lishe Bora from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Lishe Bora. (skill: practise Lishe Bora in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Lishe Bora”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Lishe Bora in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Lishe Bora to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Lishe Bora means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Lishe Bora from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Lishe Bora in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Lishe Bora from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Lishe Bora: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Lishe Bora?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Lishe Bora means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Lishe Bora means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Lishe Bora from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
